Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketeer position at Prado. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your fast-growing, award-winning company.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have hands-on experience with Google Ads, Google Analytics, and SEMrush, and I am eager to expand my skills in paid advertising and e-commerce platforms like Shopify and Klaviyo.

I am particularly drawn to Prado's innovative approach and international growth. My data-driven mindset and ability to work independently align well with your needs. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving.

I would love to bring my technical and creative skills to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketeer position at Prado. Your mission to build invisible home technology for the world's best architects and your rapid international growth truly inspire me. As a junior digital marketer with a technical edge, I am eager to contribute to your performance marketing efforts and help drive growth across your brands.

In my current role at Episto, I have developed a solid foundation in digital marketing. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I regularly use Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and guide decisions. While my focus has been on organic growth, I have also gained experience with Google Ads and am keen to deepen my expertise in paid channels like Meta and TikTok Ads.

I am particularly drawn to Prado's emphasis on data-driven optimization and A/B testing. My analytical mindset and problem-solving skills will help me identify opportunities and improve campaign performance. I am comfortable working independently and thrive in fast-paced environments. My experience with structured data and technical SEO on my own project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to learn and apply new concepts quickly.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and actively improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am open to hybrid work in Ghent.

I would be thrilled to bring my passion for digital marketing and my technical background to Prado. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
